title: I Honour Your Body Earth Mother
about: “Earth mother we honor your body, Earth mother we honor your bones…” A sweat-lodge and fire-circle song to the Earth Mother, printed in the AU book with an “Awé awé awé ya ho” refrain and a French verse (Terre mère, nous honorons ton corps). The verse melody here follows the ADF druid fellowship’s sheet of the same chant.
melody_note: Verse melody encoded from the ADF (Ár nDraíocht Féin) Earth Mother Chant sheet — pitches extracted numerically from the PDF’s glyph coordinates, rhythm as engraved in 6/8 except one over-full bar (7 eighths at “honor your bones”) normalized by reading “your” as an eighth and “bones” as a quarter; contour sanity-checked against ADF’s own audio clip (song2xml, no separation). The sheet ends on G — a whole tone below the AU book’s A-minor chording, the usual free-pitch drift. CAUTION: the ADF sheet has only the four verse lines; the songbooks’ “Awé awé awé ya ho” refrain is not on it, and its melody is still wanted.
verdict: Verdict: pending. EXTERNAL-VERIFY route — confirm the circle sings this verse shape, and supply a recording for the missing Awé refrain before promoting. Book prints 3/4 where the sheet is 6/8: same lilt written two ways; verify by ear.
